name: Jenna Berman career

name: Jenna Berman personal
content: About Jenna Berman: Born March 7, 1996, in South Florida. Gained wider attention during her 2021–2022 relationship with 49ers star Nick Bosa; later linked with MLB pitcher Jack Flaherty. Keeps her personal life notably private.
